map.仅保留指定字符 使用指南: Keep Only Specified Characters User Guide
map.反向筛选文本，仅保留你指定的字符或字符类别（如中文、数字），剔除其余内容，适合从: Reverse-filters text, keeping only the characters or character classes you specify (such as Chinese characters or digits) and discarding everything else. Ideal for pulling the needed information out of mixed text, with fully local processing.
map.反向过滤：只留含目标词的行，删掉其余，聚焦关键内容。: Reverse filtering: keep only lines containing the target word and drop the rest to focus on key content.
map.白名单抽取：从混合文本保留特定模式（如保留含订单号行）。: Whitelist extraction: keep only entries matching a pattern (for example, lines containing an order number).
map.降噪：在混乱日志里只留关心的信号。: Noise reduction: keep only the signals you care about in a messy log.
map.：1000 行文本里设保留「支付」，输出仅 42 行支付相关；与「按条件过滤」的: : with a 1000-line text, set the keep term to "Payment" and you get just the 42 relevant lines; unlike "filter by condition", it drops non-matching lines entirely instead of merely hiding them.
map.和文本过滤有什么区别？: How Does This Differ from Text Filtering?
map.文本过滤多为「显示/排除」，本工具是「仅保留匹配、丢弃其余」，输出即子集，适合直: Text filtering is mostly "show/exclude", while this tool keeps only matches and discards the rest, so the output is a subset ready to become a target list.
map.可设「任一匹配即保留」或「全部匹配才保留」，按是否需要 AND/OR 语义选择。: You can choose "keep if any matches" (OR) or "keep only if all match" (AND) depending on the semantics you need.
